what_to_detect: The inherent rad-counter trigger at the beginning of a player's precombat main phase fired, and its resolution milled cards and removed rad counters for the nonland cards milled: a radiation_change event with a negative delta (and a matching life_change).
near_miss: The rad trigger resolving with only land cards milled: card_milled events and no radiation_change or life loss. A player with no rad counters has no rad trigger at all (Forge removes the Radiation effect card), so no record exists for that case.
record_fields: trigger record fired, its source the engine-created Radiation effect card in the command zone (Mode$ Phase, Phase$ Main1, no sidecar line, so trigger_mode cannot read it)
